valid_fixes: Remove the FilterCriteria property from QueueEventSourceMapping entirely so all messages are delivered to the consumer without filtering
Restore BatchSize from 1 to 10 alongside removing FilterCriteria to match the known-good configuration
invalid_patches: Modify the FilterCriteria pattern to match 'location' field instead of 'warehouse' — adapts the filter to one field but leaves the incorrect filter mechanism in place
Modify the CSV parser handler to include a 'warehouse' key in each message body — forces the producer to satisfy a filter that should not exist
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_check_queue_depth(queue=InventoryUpdatesQueue) → visible=2, in_flight=0 — messages present but consumer never invoked
ace_check_event_source(function=SQSToDynamoDBFunction) → state=Enabled, batch_size=1 — mapping enabled but unusual batch size flag
ace_get_log_tail(function=SQSToDynamoDBFunction) → zero invocations despite messages present — implies filter rejecting all messages
ace_describe_resource(resource=QueueEventSourceMapping) → FilterCriteria requires body.warehouse=A; CSV messages use 'location' not 'warehouse'
ace_check_queue_depth(queue=InventoryUpdatesDlq) → DLQ accumulating messages — confirms messages received and rejected, not silently lost
observable_symptom: The file parser runs and messages appear in the work queue. The consumer function is never invoked despite the queue-to-function binding appearing enabled. After several minutes the messages disappear from the main queue and accumulate in the dead-letter queue. No records are written to the database.
root_cause: QueueEventSourceMapping has a FilterCriteria requiring the message body to contain a key named 'warehouse' with value 'A'. The CSV parser produces messages using keys from the CSV header row (product_id, location, quantity, update_date) — none of which is 'warehouse'. Every message fails the filter and is never delivered to the consumer. BatchSize is also reduced to 1 so each message is evaluated individually and fails the filter independently. After 5 failed receive attempts (maxReceiveCount), messages move to the DLQ.
